module: Offline build tool: for a list of levels, starts each level in freeroam, waits for it to load then triggers imposter compilation (Engine.Render.updateImposters(true)). A counter tied to the console logs is used to wait for the engine to finish working. If the duration exceeds 6000 frames without the job finishing, the game exits (shutdown(0)).
notes: The extension sets itself to manual unload (setExtensionUnloadMode) in onInit.

Sequence per level: wait for core_levels and freeroam_freeroam, wait for mods to be activated (onModManagerReady), 10 s, level start (attempts every 8 s), 120 s, wait for a period without logs, updateImposters, 20 s, another wait without logs.
logCooldown: set to 6000 on each log line (onConsoleLog), decremented every frame (onPreRender); the waits end when it reaches 0.
Only one job at a time: a second call during processing logs an error and returns false. Otherwise the function returns nothing.
A frame value is reset to 0 at the steps; if frame exceeds 6000 without being reset to 0, the game exits (timeout).

compileImposters.desc: Starts processing a queue of levels in a job (one job at a time).

queue.desc: Level names to process (passed to freeroam_freeroam.startFreeroamByName).

returns.desc: false if processing is already in progress, otherwise nil.

onInit.desc: Initialization hook: sets the extension to manual unload.

onPreRender.desc: Hook called before each render: counts down logCooldown and monitors the maximum delay (6000 frames) during processing.

onModManagerReady.desc: Hook called when the mod manager is ready: allows the job to continue.

onConsoleLog.desc: Hook called on each log line; resets logCooldown to 6000 (the engine is considered active).
